data.turoyo: U ʕAmmo Išoʕ xəd maḥkəyono, heš, hawne kayiso yo w b dukṯe yo; kmətʕaǧabno asas aydarbo bnele am məštawoṯo du zabnayḏe ḥḏo b ḥḏo, ʕam kalo w ḥaṯno.
data.translation: Uncle Isho, as a storyteller, still has his mind in good condition and in its place; I marvel, really, at how he enumerated the weddings of his time one by one, with bride and bridegroom.

rationale: Third Infectum I.1 example; narrator's explicit how-clause supplies the stimulus of wondering. Jan translation is machine-generated.

summary: All five supplied occurrences already appear verbatim in the entry at 2/103 and 29/75,256,263,504. No examples or new boxes are added.

The experiencer is l-marked with the Preterit l-series at 29/256, while Infectum has personal suffixes, including the feminine first-person -ono in 29/75 and masculine -no in 29/263. Stimuli occur as following statements or a question.
German Ich möchte wissen at 29/263 expresses the context of wondering; it does not prove a distinct wanting-to-know sense. Retain I 1 sich wundern.
